Profile Summary  
Risk and Control Professional with over 11 years of experience across financial services operations, 
specialized in control testing, RCSA, and risk governance. Demonstrated expertise in end -to-end risk 
assessment, operational resilience, and regulatory com pliance (CASS, REMS). Proven ability to lead 
and mentor high -performing teams within control environments, driving excellence in stakeholder 
management and audit remediation. Skilled at conducting comprehensive risk reviews, executing 
large-scale control validations and continuously enhancing frameworks to deliver e ffective risk 
mitigation and compliance assurance for global operations.  
  
  
Work Experience  
 Northern Trust Corporation, Bengaluru  Sept 2014 – Feb 2026  
  
Consultant, Officer  
Enterprise Risk Management - BU Control Testing

Self-Assessment to strengthen risk mitigation and ensure regulatory compliance across 
complex business processes.

ensure robust control frameworks across multiple business functions.

Computing tools, implementing remediation strategies to safeguard data integrity.  
• Proactively assess emerging risks, design action plans, and mitigate control weaknesses to 
ensure business resilience.  
• Proven track record of leading strategic initiatives, identifying and addressing control gaps, 
and driving continuous improvement in operational efficiency.  
• Strong experience in stakeholder management, collaborating with cross-functional teams and 
senior leaders to implement solutions that mitigate risks and align with business objectives.  
• Skilled in optimizing business operations, enhancing workflows, and ensuring compliance with 
industry regulations.  
• Demonstrated leadership in managing cross -functional teams, delivering process 
improvements and executing large-scale initiatives to drive business outcomes.  
• Lead loss event data collection, validation and non -financial risk analysis initiatives across 
business lines and geographies.  
• Performed control testing across Custody and Securities Services processes, specifically 
covering CASS and REMS controls, assessing control effectiveness, identifying gaps, and 
supporting remediation activities across 1LOD and 2LOD environments.  
• Monitored regulatory requirements and changes impacting Custody/Securities Services, 
reviewed CASS and REMS requirements, assessed control effectiveness and gaps, and 
supported the implementation and enhancement of compliance frameworks, SOPs and 
controls.  
• Conducted root cause analysis on operational failures and loss events, developed mitigation 
strategies and control recommendations.  
• Performed risk assessment, quality control, audit procedures and prepared monthly reports
